notes:
v4.6.37 — Installer is now self-healing (fixes the sklearn install-skip)

🐛 FIXED — v4.6.36 sklearn 'No module named __check_build' on installed app
• v4.6.36's build was correct (the bundled sklearn included its compiled __check_build subpackage), but if APEX.exe was running during the silent in-app update, Inno Setup couldn't replace files inside _internal\ and silently skipped the new sklearn/__check_build folder. Bot would then crash at 'from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression'.
• Installer now force-kills any running APEX.exe in PrepareToInstall BEFORE copying files, so a silent /VERYSILENT update can't leave a half-installed bundle.
• [InstallDelete] wipes _internal\ before copying so any leftover partial sub-package from a prior interrupted install gets freshly created.
• Files use the 'ignoreversion' flag so the installer always replaces _internal contents regardless of version/timestamp.

What to do:
• Update normally via the in-app banner — this installer now handles itself.
• If your CURRENT install is broken (the v4.6.36 sklearn issue): you can also fully Quit APEX (check Task Manager → no APEX.exe), then run installer\APEX_Setup.exe from the v4.6.37 release.
